info.brief: Google User Messaging Platform consent API for Android. The table is absent on other platforms.
info.description: Google User Messaging Platform consent API for Android. The table is absent on other platforms.

elements.name: ump.request_consent_info_update
elements.description:
Request fresh consent information and show a consent form if required.
Call on every launch. The callback runs on the Defold update thread after
the update and any required form finish unless defer_form is true. In
deferred mode the callback runs after the information update, before any
form opens; call show_consent_form_if_required to finish the flow.
A successful callback means no UMP error, not consent to personalized ads.

parameters.name: test_device
parameters.doc: Enable UMP debug mode and force EEA geography for the registered test device.

parameters.name: test_device_hashed_id
parameters.doc: Hashed test device ID. Pass an empty string when test_device is false.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Called when the update and any required form finish.

fields.name: success
fields.doc: False if the consent information update or form failed.

parameters.name: defer_form
parameters.doc: Pause after the information update so an application notice can precede a required form. Defaults to false.

elements.examples:
ump.request_consent_info_update(false, "", function(self, success)
    if success and ump.can_request_ads() then
        print("Ads can be requested")
    end
end)

elements.name: ump.show_consent_form_if_required
elements.description:
Continue a successful deferred consent-information update. Check
was_consent_form_required() to decide whether to show an application
notice first. Call only once, after that notice has closed. The callback
runs after the required form closes or fails, or immediately if no form
is required. Advertising must wait for this callback.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Called when the form step finishes.

fields.name: success
fields.doc: False if the form could not be loaded or shown.

elements.name: ump.show_privacy_options_form
elements.description:
Open the UMP privacy-options form in response to user input. Check
is_privacy_options_required() first. A successful callback means the form
closed without an error, not that the user granted consent.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: Called after the privacy-options form is dismissed or fails.

fields.name: success
fields.doc: False if the form could not be shown or completed.

elements.examples:
if ump.is_privacy_options_required() then
    ump.show_privacy_options_form(function(self, success)
        if success then print("Privacy options closed") end
    end)
end

elements.name: ump.is_privacy_options_required
elements.description: Whether UMP requires a privacy-options entry point. Returns false before consent information is available.

returnvalues.name: required
returnvalues.doc: True when a privacy-options entry point is required.

elements.name: ump.can_request_ads
elements.description:
UMP ad-request eligibility. Check after the current update callback.
Before then, this can reflect consent stored from an earlier session.

returnvalues.name: allowed
returnvalues.doc: True when UMP allows ad requests.

elements.name: ump.get_consent_status
elements.description:
Google consent status: 0 unknown, 1 not required, 2 required, 3 obtained.
Returns -1 before the consent-information object exists. Status 3 does
not distinguish personalized from non-personalized advertising.

returnvalues.name: status
returnvalues.doc: UMP consent status or -1 if unavailable.

elements.name: ump.get_request_state
elements.description:
Diagnostic state of the latest consent information update and form.
Prefer the request callback to polling this value.

returnvalues.name: state
returnvalues.doc: One of ump.REQUEST_STATE_UPDATING, ump.REQUEST_STATE_FORM_PENDING, ump.REQUEST_STATE_COMPLETE, or ump.REQUEST_STATE_FAILED.

elements.name: ump.was_consent_form_required
elements.description:
Whether the latest successful information update found a required normal
consent form. Resets when a new update starts. May remain true if that
form later fails.

returnvalues.name: required
returnvalues.doc: True if the latest successful update required a form.

elements.name: ump.get_privacy_options_state
elements.description: Diagnostic state of the latest privacy-options form.

returnvalues.name: state
returnvalues.doc: One of ump.PRIVACY_OPTIONS_STATE_NOT_SHOWN, ump.PRIVACY_OPTIONS_STATE_SHOWING, ump.PRIVACY_OPTIONS_STATE_DISMISSED, or ump.PRIVACY_OPTIONS_STATE_ERROR.

elements.name: ump.get_gdpr_applies
elements.description:
Read IABTCF_gdprApplies from Android default preferences after a
successful UMP update. This is a GDPR applicability signal, not a country
code or vendor consent.

returnvalues.name: value
returnvalues.doc: ump.GDPR_APPLIES_NO, ump.GDPR_APPLIES_YES, or ump.GDPR_APPLIES_UNKNOWN if missing or invalid.

elements.name: ump.get_purpose_consents
elements.description:
Read the raw IABTCF_PurposeConsents bit string from Android default
preferences. Call after a successful UMP update or privacy-options
callback. The third character represents TCF Purpose 3 consent.

returnvalues.name: value
returnvalues.doc: Raw purpose-consent bit string, or nil if unavailable.

elements.name: ump.reset_consent_information
elements.description:
Clear UMP consent information for testing if its object has been created.
Start a new request afterward. Diagnostic request/form states are not
reset by this call.

elements.name: ump.initialize_mobile_ads_sdk
elements.description:
Legacy, nonfunctional export. Its required Java method is absent from
this extension. Do not call it. If using the Defold AdMob extension,
call admob.initialize() after the UMP flow instead.

elements.name: ump.REQUEST_STATE_UPDATING
elements.brief: 0; initial state or consent information update in progress.
elements.description: 0; initial state or consent information update in progress.

elements.name: ump.REQUEST_STATE_COMPLETE
elements.brief: 1; update and form step finished without a UMP error.
elements.description: 1; update and form step finished without a UMP error.

elements.name: ump.REQUEST_STATE_FAILED
elements.description: 2; information update or form failed.

elements.name: ump.REQUEST_STATE_FORM_PENDING
elements.brief: 3; update succeeded and the form step is waiting or in progress.
elements.description: 3; update succeeded and the form step is waiting or in progress.

elements.name: ump.PRIVACY_OPTIONS_STATE_NOT_SHOWN
elements.description: 0; initial privacy-options state.

elements.name: ump.PRIVACY_OPTIONS_STATE_SHOWING
elements.description: 1; privacy-options request in progress.

elements.name: ump.PRIVACY_OPTIONS_STATE_DISMISSED
elements.brief: 2; privacy-options form closed without a UMP error.
elements.description: 2; privacy-options form closed without a UMP error.

elements.name: ump.PRIVACY_OPTIONS_STATE_ERROR
elements.description: 3; privacy-options form failed.

elements.name: ump.GDPR_APPLIES_UNKNOWN
elements.brief: -1; IAB TCF GDPR applicability value missing or invalid.
elements.description: -1; IAB TCF GDPR applicability value missing or invalid.

elements.name: ump.GDPR_APPLIES_NO
elements.brief: 0; IAB TCF value says GDPR does not apply.
elements.description: 0; IAB TCF value says GDPR does not apply.

elements.name: ump.GDPR_APPLIES_YES
elements.brief: 1; IAB TCF value says GDPR applies.
elements.description: 1; IAB TCF value says GDPR applies.
